## 2. Architectural Philosophy & Core Tenets
1. **Deterministic Precision at AI Speed:**
   Leveraging agentic workflows and LLM reasoning layers not as superficial wrappers, but as orchestrated state machines backed by rigorous schema validation (Pydantic v2) and relational/vector persistence (PostgreSQL + pgvector).
2. **Sub-20ms Telemetry & Resilient Streams:**
   Architecting asynchronous non-blocking I/O using Python AsyncIO, WebSockets, and Server-Sent Events to provide real-time reactive feedback without polling overhead.
3. **Multi-Brand Scoped Design Systems:**
   Designing user interfaces where each product preserves an authentic visual identity (distinct typography, color psychology, and micro-interactions) while maintaining global web performance and zero layout shift (CLS < 0.1).

## 3. Deep Architectural Breakdown of Production Ecosystem

### 1. Khonshu — Agentic Quantitative Trading Terminal
- **Production URL:** https://khonshu.ir/
- **Domain:** Fintech / Algorithmic Trading / Quantitative Systems
- **Core Problem:** High-frequency crypto trading interfaces often suffer from UI lag, delayed orderbook rendering, and unverified AI signals.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Fast bidirectional WebSocket streaming (`Cortex_WS`) delivering sub-20ms latency updates.
  - OKLCH laser color spaces with Tailwind CSS v4 for high-contrast tabular number visualization.
  - Multi-exchange adapter architecture for real-time market radar scanning, toxic flow detection, and volume shock absorption.
- **Technologies:** FastAPI, Python 3.12, AsyncIO, WebSockets, Tailwind v4 (OKLCH tokens), Redis.

### 2. Najvagram — High-Security Anonymous Transit & Messaging
- **Domain:** Social / Privacy Engineering / Cryptographic Communication
- **Production URL:** https://najvagram.ir/
- **Core Problem:** Digital surveillance and lack of genuine psychological safety in conventional messaging platforms.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Ephemeral "train compartment" communication model: passengers enter with temporary access keys and leave no permanent digital footprint.
  - End-to-end payload encryption utilizing HKDF-derived AES-256 keys.
  - Zero-log memory-backed sessions with Shadow Mode for complete anonymity.
  - 12-tier progression gamification engine with asynchronous station mural signaling.
- **Technologies:** Flask, WebSockets, AES-256 HKDF, Redis Pub/Sub, CSS Modules.

### 3. Lyraz — Collaborative Sound Grid & Music Bot
- **Domain:** Multimedia / Real-time Audio Streaming
- **Production URL:** https://lyraz.ir/landing
- **Core Problem:** Disconnected audio playback across Telegram chat communities and web clients without synchronized lyrics.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Dual interface architecture: Telegram bot controls paired with a web audio player.
  - Real-time lyrics synchronization (Live Lyrics) over WebSockets.
  - High-fidelity 320kbps lossless streaming pipeline with dynamic audio equalizers and Spotify track synchronization.
- **Technologies:** Telegram Bot API, Web Audio API, WebSockets, Spotify API, Python, Plus Jakarta Sans & Anton typography.

### 4. DoneSpace — Shared Household OS & Productivity System
- **Domain:** Productivity / Household Task Optimization
- **Production URL:** https://donespace.ir/
- **Core Problem:** Friction and chore imbalance among housemates and co-living arrangements.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Fair-share queue rotation algorithms with gamified XP rewards.
  - Automated weekly meal scheduler integrated with Google Calendar API.
  - Progressive Web App (PWA) offline-first architecture with PostgreSQL persistence.
- **Technologies:** Python, Flask, Google Calendar API, PWA, PostgreSQL, Playfair Display & Outfit typography.

### 5. m0j — Systemic Life Architecture & Identity Matrix
- **Domain:** Personal Knowledge Management / Gamified Development
- **Production URL:** https://m0j.ir/
- **Core Problem:** Fragmented goal-setting tools that isolate professional work from emotional, physical, and relational life pillars.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - 8-domain scaffold (Mind, Body, Skill, Relations, Experience, Adventure, Impact, Finance).
  - Epic quest progression engine with real-time XP accumulation streamed via Server-Sent Events.
  - Interactive radar spectrum and Spring physics transitions for tactile visual feedback.
- **Technologies:** FastAPI, Server-Sent Events (SSE), Chart.js, Spring CSS animations, Hanken Grotesk.

### 6. AnkiSynth AI — AI Knowledge Forge & Spaced Repetition Engine
- **Domain:** EdTech / Artificial Intelligence / Spaced Repetition
- **Production URL:** https://mahdi0jafari.github.io/AnkiSynth/
- **Core Problem:** Creating high-retention atomic flashcards from dense academic literature is mentally taxing and time-consuming.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Multi-turn AI synthesis engine powered by Google Gemini 3.1 Flash.
  - Automated extraction of declarative and procedural concepts into atomic cloze cards.
  - In-browser IndexedDB storage with Dexie.js and client-side binary `.apkg` file compilation for direct Anki import.
- **Technologies:** Next.js 15, TypeScript, Google Gemini API, Dexie.js, APKG generator.

### 7. Fanus (فانوس) — Emotional Digital Sanctuary & Night-time Archive
- **Domain:** Creative Expression / Micro-journaling
- **Production URL:** https://fanus-space.ir/
- **Core Problem:** Lack of quiet, reflective, judgment-free spaces on the modern internet.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Warm candlelight aesthetic with dynamic pulsing animations and charcoal surfaces.
  - SQLite WAL (Write-Ahead Logging) database with Server-Sent Events stream for anonymous thought exchanges.
  - Persian typographical rhythm with Vazirmatn ExtraLight.
- **Technologies:** Flask, SQLite (WAL mode), SSE stream, Vanilla CSS.

### 8. CoWorkMap × BlueWhite (آبی‌سفید) — Iran Coworking Directory
- **Domain:** Geospatial Intelligence / Workspace Directory
- **Production URL:** http://coworkmap.ir/
- **Core Problem:** Finding verified coworking amenities, high-speed fiber internet availability, and room booking across Iranian cities.
- **Architectural Solution:**
  - Interactive geospatial directory cataloging 340+ verified coworking hubs.
  - Direct integration with Neshan Maps routing API for turn-by-turn navigation.
  - Official partnership and reservation portal for BlueWhite branches.
- **Technologies:** Vue 3, Vite, Vuetify, Neshan Maps API, GeoJSON.

## 4. Personal Portfolio Architecture (mahdijafari.ir)
- **Frontend Framework:** Next.js 15 (App Router, React Server Components, TypeScript)
- **Styling Architecture:** Tailwind CSS, Scoped CSS Modules, Custom OKLCH/HSL palettes
- **Artificial Intelligence Assistant:** In-terminal interactive RAG chatbot powered by Google Gemini 3.1 and LangGraph
- **Backend Service:** FastAPI (Python 3.12) with asynchronous SQLAlchemy sessions
- **Storage & Queues:** PostgreSQL with pgvector, Redis cache and rate limiting, Arq async worker queue
- **Infrastructure:** Containerized with Docker and Docker Compose, reverse-proxied behind Nginx with SSL/TLS termination and automated GitHub Actions CI/CD.
